title: Harishankar Bagla v. State of Madhya Pradesh

content.caseIdentity: Harishankar Bagla v. State of Madhya Pradesh, AIR 1954 SC 465; (1955) 1 SCR 380
content.facts: The validity of delegated powers under the Essential Supplies legislation was challenged.
questionsBeforeCourt: Can Parliament delegate rule-making power where the parent statute lays down policy and standards?
content.ratioDecidendi: Delegation is valid where the legislature has itself determined the policy and provides sufficient guidance for subordinate rule-making.
content.holding: The Court upheld the delegation in the circumstances.
content.relevance: Use for statutory policy and guidance as the source of delegated rule-making power.
